blockers.title: A changed D3 source tree can reuse the old phone PASS
blockers.evidence: scripts/milestone.mjs:262-285 verifies the captured commit, agent evidence and saved verification digest. At completion, :495-501 compares against the captured digest but never checks whether current source changes belong to explicitly permitted independent work. A synthetic probe changed and committed app.mjs after handoff without starting M2; after recording a PASS for the old build, complete("M1") still printed M1: COMPLETE.
blockers.reproduction: Hand off M1, change and commit app.mjs without starting a dependent milestone, record owner PASS for the captured commit, sweep the plan, then call complete("M1"). It succeeds. The pending milestone’s source changed without resume or a fresh handoff.

blockers.title: Completion accepts an owner evidence file that contradicts its PASS
blockers.evidence: scripts/milestone.mjs:210 excludes ownerEvidence from the handoff evidence hashes; completion checks required-file presence and ownerCompletionProblems on the queue, but does not validate the report contents against that queue result. A synthetic probe replaced the required physical report with a CHANGES_REQUESTED report after the queue recorded PASS; complete("M1") still printed M1: COMPLETE.
blockers.reproduction: Hand off M1, record a matching owner PASS, replace its required physical-device-review.json with a contradictory report, sweep the plan, then call complete("M1"). Completion succeeds.
